'''Hellhound Hunters''' are monsters released with [[The Zamorakian Undercity]]. Two of these can be found in the northeastern section of the undercity, along with a [[Hellhound Alpha]] and the miniboss [[Desha, Guardian of the Hounds]]. Neither the alpha nor the hunters can leave the small area where they are found, although Desha can.

Their attacks can inflict the [[Savage Wounds]] bleed.

==Trivia==

* The Hellhound Hunter used to possess the [[Strong guard (status)|Strong guard]] status, which made the players' attacks incapable of missing and made their [[Ability damage|damage]] dependent on their [[Hit chance|accuracy]]; this was effectively replaced by the damage potential system on [[4 March]] [[2024]].
